description: An opaque part inside a constituent that emits ε gives nothing and is no opaque part: `word` sounds and shows only `a`, and `hidden` takes in no text, so `tail`, the next opaque part, takes the uncovered `!` before it (engine §5, §11).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau %ambiguity-resolution greedy %rule text [{part}] %rule part letter | pause | mark %rule letter 'a' | 'b' | 'c' | 'd' %emits $ %rule pause ' '

%emits $ %rule mark '!' ```
documents.h.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $w(word) $f(tail)
%emits $w <W>, $f <F>
%rule word L gone
%rule gone hidden
%emits ε
%rule hidden L
%opaque
%rule tail L
%opaque
```
